balanced_comparison.decision: Close client-ledger lever after this reverse-order confirmation; retain exact-output, fault and durability controls; prioritize sampler/device service attribution. No further confirmation campaign.

control.definition: Descriptive equal-block pooling of 18 within-block intervals across two runs; no interblock intervals or independent-trial confidence claim.

fast.definition: Descriptive equal-block pooling of 18 within-block intervals across two runs; no interblock intervals or independent-trial confidence claim.

descriptors.scope: Finite passive observation; no leak-freedom or endurance claim.

limits: Two separate applications, each with one short ordered pair; order reversal supports direction but is not randomized repetition, an independent-trial confidence estimate, endurance or a public record.
Same ten fixture graphs/numerics, geometry, serial delivery and durability policy logic; setup/proof work and runtime age can differ between blocks/processes.
Coordinator reports quiet timing, with root/agents paused and same passive FD observer. No new driver-accounting observer was added to105.
Exactness scoped to original ten fixtures at640x384 and four tensors; no unseen-prompt/longer-video/general visual-quality claim.
Metadata-only analysis; independent full tensor reconstruction owned by coordinator.

method.client_gap: Next server execution_start minus preceding server execution_success; receive-span excess is local receive elapsed start-to-success minus server start-to-success, not an absolute one-way delay or removable GPU idle bound.
method.counts: Policy totals include all14 requests/fourfills, count checkpoint calls only, not explicit attempt/prompt/completion saves or event-log fsyncs. Fast/checkpoint event counts may change because delivery speed changes progress observations.
method.evidence: Hash-bound small metadata/source/log analysis only; no tensor rescan or endpoint actions.
method.primary: 25 generated frames per clip divided by mean of nine server-success intervals within each ten-emission block. Four fills and interblock verification/reset gap excluded. Playback 24fps.
method.stage_matching: For emitted fixture i, sampler receipt request i+2 (emitted_index matches), decoder and prompt-node receipts request i+4. Worker phases are elapsed service times spanning both sampler devices, not per-device busy utilization.

quality.comparison: Exact video/audio latent, image and waveform tensors in stored verifier receipts; independent full tensor proof reconstruction is owned by coordinator.

source_comparison.client_change: Only schedule SHA and __init__ ordering of fast_rows/timed_rows; execute/checkpoint/save_state/event handling are AST-identical.
